no_go_reasons: The frozen history_user_template did not byte-generate the controller's archived user message.
A syntactically plausible but fabricated Stage-A seal could unlock Stage B.
Review intake did not bind the submitted template, receipt and provenance to the protected mapping and replayed frozen run.
Raw provenance bytes, intake reports and genuine immutable stage seals were not archived as an official fixed-path workflow.
The public mapping digest did not identify the actual protected mapping file bytes.
Stage-B pre-lock exposure was not incorporated into provenance classification and no Stage-B finalizer/unblind gate existed.
Prospective human semantic, Persona Fidelity and history-handling estimands and missing-outcome bounds were incomplete.
A recoverable HTTP-200 completion without a RAW journal event, or a repeatedly failing result derivation, could break 168-slot replay.
scientific_interpretation: V2 is a preserved negative design-review outcome, not an empirical model or human-review result.
